0022600120.text: The Cavaliers (1-1) host the Timberwolves (3-0) as they play their third game of the season, sitting 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 9th in the East after a 1-0 home start and a 1-1 record over their last two games. Minnesota is unbeaten, riding a three-game winning streak, and is 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, though Donte DiVincenzo is out following Achilles surgery. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Cleveland winning the most recent meeting 146-134 in Cleveland on January 10, 2026.
